subject: POC success criteria, owners & executive decision review
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Jacobs <emily.jacobs@novumhealth.com>, Mark Sutton <mark.sutton@novumhealth.com>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-12-13T15:08:00-08:00
Subject: POC success criteria, owners & executive decision review

Hi Emily / Mark —

Great conversation earlier today. Per our call, summary and suggested next steps below so we have everything lined up for the trial window and final decision review.

1) High-level objective
- Validate that Redwood Inference can deliver consistent 95th %-tile latency < 250ms for your clinical triage use-case at the 8 qps traffic profile, while preserving model output quality for the 3 core templates you showed.

2) Success criteria (what Novum will sign off on at final review)
- Latency: 95th %-tile < 250ms (staging traffic replay, production-like inputs)
- Throughput: Sustained 8 qps with <5% token loss over a 1-hour soak
- Quality: Acceptable answer rate >= 92% on your gold prompt set (file attached: novum_eval_success_metrics.csv)
- Data security: End-to-end in VPC, keys in KMS; no logs retained beyond 30 days unless flagged.

3) Proposed trial timeline (tentative)
- Week 0 (1/5–1/9): Account setup, network allowlists, KMS handshake, sample data ingest
- Week 1 (1/12–1/16): Baseline run, performance profiling, kernel/quantization tuning
- Week 2 (1/19–1/23): Production-like replay, soak, and quality evals
- Week 3 (1/26–1/30): Final analysis & exec decision packet prepared

4) Owners (please confirm)
- Novum technical lead: Emily Jacobs (you) — data, gold set, accept/reject on quality
- Novum procurement/legal: Mark Sutton + procurement@novumhealth.com — contracting and PO
- Redwood: Vivek Kulkarni — trial orchestration & exec coordination; Rishi Malhotra — infra & on-call for profiling; Jasmine Liu — success metrics and pilot ops

5) Logistics / asks for this week
- Emily: share the gold prompt set and a small (10k token) sample dataset for the baseline run by Fri 12/17
- Mark / Procurement: share any standard terms or redlines we should anticipate (or confirm using the SOW template attached)
- Novum: please nominate your exec reviewer(s) for the final decision meeting (30–45 min) — ideally VP-level who can sign off on go/no-go and next contracting step

6) Attachments & links
- Attached: NovumHealth_POC-SOW_v0.9.pdf, novum_eval_success_metrics.csv
- HubSpot record & Drive link in the footer for reference

If the owners/timeline above look good I’ll get dates blocked for the setup week and schedule a tentative 30-minute exec decision meeting for Jan 29 or Jan 30 (two options) — we’ll firm the slot once the trial data run completes.

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: NovumHealth_POC-SOW_v0.9.pdf (PDF), novum_eval_success_metrics.csv (CSV)
From: Emily Jacobs <emily.jacobs@novumhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Mark Sutton <mark.sutton@novumhealth.com>, procurement@novumhealth.com
Date: 2026-12-14T09:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC success criteria, owners & executive decision review

Thanks Vivek — really useful write-up and aligned with what we discussed. A few quick items: 

- We confirm Emily as technical lead and Mark as procurement contact. I’ll also loop in Dr. Priya Rao (VP Clinical Ops) once we lock the exec meeting slot — she’ll be the decision owner for quality.
- I’ll upload the gold prompt set and a 12k-token sample to the Drive folder by EOD Friday (12/17).
- On the latency metric: can you confirm whether the 95th %-tile target is measured with prefix caching enabled? We have some long conversational histories in prod; want to make sure the measurement matches our replay script.

Also: we reviewed the SOW draft and have two procurement asks: 
1) A two-week cancellation clause during the POC for residual liabilities
2) Standard Novum PO terms for payment net-45

I’ll aim to get those formalities noted so procurement can move quickly. Otherwise we’re optimistic about the timeline.

—Emily

Looping our internal owners so we can move the SOW and trial ops forward. Quick notes from our side: 

- Rishi: can you confirm the network allowlist checklist and any infra pre-reqs we should pass to Novum for the Week 0 setup? I’ll include a short onboarding checklist in the Drive folder.
- Laura: procurement asked about the two-week cancellation clause Emily referenced — do we want to propose specific language (liability cap, data deletion window) or hand off to legal for markup?
- Lauren: can you prepare the decision packet template (one-pager with metrics + recommendation) so we have consistent format for the Jan decision meeting? I can populate once runs are complete.

We should also plan the interim checkpoints (end of Week 1 and end of Week 2) as 30-minute syncs with Novum tech and ops. Suggested cadence: Tues 10am PT (Week 1 check) and Thurs 10am PT (Week 2 soak review).

Jasmine

--
Jasmine Liu

Thanks — quick infra checklist: 
- Allowlist: Novum IPs + SSH jumpbox (we’ll provide range)
- KMS exchange: standard RSA-encrypted key wrap; need contact at Novum KMS admin (Emily?)
- Data: provide 10–15 sample conversations (anonymized) for profiling; any PHI must be hashed/removed per our agreement
- Observability: we’ll share a pre-configured Grafana read-only dashboard for the soak; share list of Novum watcher emails we should grant access to.

I’ll draft the exact allowlist CIDR and KMS steps today and add to the Drive folder.

—Rishi

Subject: Scheduling decision review — two date options (Jan 29 or Jan 30)

Hi all —

Thanks again — everything is looking good on our side. Per earlier, we’d like to lock the executive decision meeting now so Novum can secure the right reviewers. Please confirm which of these two 45-minute windows works best for your team: 

- Option A: Thu, Jan 29, 2027 — 11:00–11:45am PT
- Option B: Fri, Jan 30, 2027 — 9:00–9:45am PT

Agenda (30–35 min + 10–15 min Q&A):
- 5 min: Context & trial objective (Vivek)
- 10 min: Performance & reliability summary (Rishi)
- 10 min: Quality evaluation vs gold set (Jasmine)
- 5 min: Recommendation & contract next steps (Laura / Lauren)

Deliverables we’ll share 48 hours prior to the meeting: final metric packet (PDF), replay logs (redacted), and the SOW with procurement markup (DocuSign link if ready).

Emily — when you confirm the date, I’ll send a calendar invite and a preliminary decision packet template. If procurement needs pre-signed SOW language, Laura and I can do a quick call to align on the two-week trial cancellation wording.

Best — Vivek

--
